# stockroom

A tiny stock-keeping library: add items, take them out, and list what is low. Standard-library Python only, so
there is nothing to install.

## Commands

- `make test` runs the unit tests.
- `make lint` runs the house style check (`tools/style_check.py`).
- `make typecheck` compiles every module, which catches syntax errors.

The code lives in `src/stockroom/` and the tests in `tests/`.
